recentItems.description:

Suresh Kochattil About Chalo Delhi Protest & Amit shah Maha Padayatra | Modi | Rahul gandhi | iDream


Congress "Chalo Delhi" Reality Check: Analyzing the Ramleela Maidan rally, mock parliament, and why street protests without ground-level election strategy won't defeat a well-oiled BJP machine.

The 13-22 Crore Voter List Controversy: Deep dive into Special Intensive Revision (SIR), missing voters, Supreme Court rulings, and systemic data gaps like death certificates in rural areas.

Amit Shah’s Mega Padayatra & Youth Strategy: How the BJP is starting early, targeting youth voters, and executing focused campaigns across states like UP and Punjab well ahead of schedule.

State-Level Power Plays:

Punjab: Shifting focus to the drug crisis and historic reconciliation with old allies.

Uttar Pradesh: Akhilesh Yadav's temple politics vs. BJP's counter-strategy.

Kerala & West Bengal: Tribunals, voter deletions, and the shifting loyalties of TMC/CPM cadres.

The Ultimate Political Lesson: Why winning elections requires disciplined grassroots execution rather than temporary protests, explained pin-to-pin by Suresh Kochattil.
